articles.title: OpenAI still doesn’t seem to have a handle on all of its rogue AI activity
articles.description: On Friday, OpenAI published a new site devoted to “misalignment reports” and the breadth of the incidents is alarming.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: Reddit is killing RSS feeds and ending public API access because of AI bots
articles.description: Reddit is ending support for RSS feeds, as the company continues tightening access to its trove of user-generated content.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Apple says it’s tightening macOS ‘Full Disk Access’ controls due to new risks from AI agents
articles.description: Apple says it will add new controls around macOS’s Full Disk Access permission, warning that increasingly capable AI agents make broad access to users’ files, messages, mail, and browsing history riskier.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Musk’s AI chatbot Grok reportedly encouraged Trump to capture  Venezuela’s president
articles.description: President Trump reportedly asked for Grok's opinion before invading Venezuela and capturing Nicolás Maduro.
articles.author: Dominic-Madori Davis

articles.title: OpenAI cuts ties with 3 safety researchers, WSJ reports
articles.description: OpenAI has parted ways with three safety researchers after an internal investigation found they mishandled sensitive company information, report says.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: AMD will acquire Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2B
articles.description: The acquisition will see World Labs founder Fei-Fei Li join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: Insurers claim AI is already increasing healthcare costs
articles.description: Blue Cross Blue Shield says hospital use of AI tools led to an additional $942 million in healthcare spending over a two-year period.
articles.author: Anthony Ha

articles.title: Anthropic’s prospectus details losses, growth, and, yes, a warning that its AI could end humanity
articles.description: In its prospectus, Anthropic just told investors it's losing tens of billions of dollars a year, but also growing like crazy, and — oh yeah — its own AI might pose an existential risk to humanity.
articles.author: Connie Loizos

articles.title: Viral AI agent Instinct raises $1B Series C at a $10B valuation
articles.description: "This funding helps us bring Instinct to more people and continue building the future of personal AI. It’s an exciting, creative time, and we're just getting started," founder Noah Shinn said in a statement.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI around music
articles.description: Sean Parker, who once taught the music industry what asking for forgiveness looks like, is now back with the labels' blessing and money.
articles.author: Connie Loizos
